test_policy.notes: Test-optional since the 2021 terms: applicants choose on the application whether IU East considers SAT/ACT scores. The School of Education requires a test score, and IU East's merit-based scholarships require submitted scores.

requirements.notes: Apply IU application (select IU East as home campus); the international page states a $65 non-refundable fee. Holistic review of diploma type (Indiana Academic Honors or Core 40 expected, comparable credits for other systems), GPA, class rank (upper half) and test scores if submitted; conditional admission may be available to those below the criteria. International applicants submit official academic records sent directly by the issuing school, with certified English translations; private credential evaluations (ECE, WES) do not replace official transcripts. The pages reviewed look partly dated (banner from 2020).

deadlines.label: Early-application scholarship date, fall
deadlines.notes: Printed as an early application scholarship date of March 1 with no year; taken as fall 2027 entry.

deadlines.label: Application priority date, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Printed as 'May 1 - Application priority date for Fall Semester' with no year; taken as fall 2027. Spring priority date is October 1. Applications are reviewed daily and the page says an update comes within 48 hours of a complete file. No separate international deadline is printed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not required for citizens of, or those with three full years of secondary school in, the listed approved English-speaking countries (e.g. Australia, Canada, UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, Nigeria, Philippines), or with 26+ credit hours from a U.S. post-secondary institution including a 100-level English composition course. Alternatives to a language test: SAT EBRW 560 or ACT English 21; STEP Eiken Pre-First Grade for residents of Japan. No ESL or conditional pathway is described for international applicants.

english.notes: Printed as a 'provisional minimum of 79+' internet-based score (also 550 paper / 213 computer-based). The page does not list the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.

aid.notes: International students are not eligible for U.S. federal aid or loans. IU East points them to IU East scholarships (use the 'Citizenship' filter) and external scholarships; no international scholarship amounts are published on the pages reviewed.

cost.notes: IU 2025-27 approved rates for IU East full-time undergraduates, 2026-27: resident tuition $7,716.78 + mandatory fee $707.34 = $8,424.12; nonresident tuition $22,547.78 + mandatory fee $707.34 = $23,255.12. International students are assumed to pay the nonresident rate; the pages do not say so explicitly. IU East has no campus housing (IPEDS), so room and board are not listed. Program differentials apply to some majors.
